review_notes: I read the whole file. The only new definition is C3aAux.walkW, a recursive count of walks on a regular tree by distance. It is built to satisfy the recurrence hypotheses of the imported HeckeTreeWalk theorems. It is not an independent version of any Mathlib concept: Mathlib has no matching tree-walk-by-depth count, and the file uses it only as a concrete witness for those hypotheses. The other C3aAux declarations are theorems or lemmas: walkW_eq_zero, centralBinom_eq_four_pow_mul_prod and collapse. The rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication, so I did not report them. The main theorem `solution` introduces no competing structure or definition. It uses existing Mathlib and project notions throughout, including Measure.addHaar, deriv, Nat.centralBinom and Ideal.absNorm. I did not search Mathlib exhaustively for the walkW recurrence, but I found no sign that it duplicates anything.
